definition.text: (1.) The father of James the Less, the apostle and writer of the epistle (Matt. 10:3; Mark 3:18; Luke 6:15; Acts 1:13), and the husband of Mary (John 19:25). The Hebrew form of this name is Cleopas, or Clopas (q.v.). (2.) The father of Levi, or Matthew (Mark 2:14).

works.title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 2, Volume 1: Eusebius — Church History, Life of Constantine, Oration in Praise of Constantine
